LESSON PLAN HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
 Week: Lesson:
 SCHOOL GRADE DATE TIME ROLL
 TWO
STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: PERSONAL HYGIENE
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: Use and care of personal items.
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to identify the items used for personal cleanliness.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 What items do we use for personal cleanliness?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
 Critical thinking  Responsibility  Health issues
 Communication and  Love  Life skills
 collaboration  Respect
  Digital literacy
  Self-efficacy
LEARNING RESOURCES
Picture of personal items.
Materials for cleaning personal items: water, soap, brush.
Computers/tablets.
Focus on Hygiene and nutrition Grade 2 learners’ workbook pg. 29-35
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Review the previous lesson.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Guide the learners to identify the items they use when taking bath.
 Step 2: Guide the learners to list and write them in their exercise books.
 Step 3: Learners to discuss how these items are used.
SUMMARY
Review the lesson
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Cleanliness in important for health
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to promote personal hygiene among family members and friends.
REFLECTION ON THE LESSON/SELF-REMARKS

STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: PERSONAL HYGIENE
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: Use and care of personal items (toothbrush)
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to:-
 a. Identify the items used for personal cleanliness
 b. Give reasons why we should not share personal items.
 c. State the procedure used when cleaning items for personal use.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 What items do we use for personal cleanliness?
 How do we clean personal items?
 Why should we not share personal items?

Review the previous lesson.

 Step 1: Guide the learners to identify the items they use when brushing their teeth.
 Step 2: Guide the learners in the steps provided in the learner’s workbook on how to clean a toothbrush.

Review the lesson

. Learners to promote personal hygiene among family members and friends.

 Week: Lesson:
 SCHOOL GRADE DATE TIME ROLL
 TWO
STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: PERSONAL HYGIENE
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: Use and care of personal items (toothbrush)
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to:-
 a) Identify materials that can be used to improvise items for personal use.
 b) Appreciate the importance of caring for personal items to promote cleanliness for self and others.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 What other materials can we use to improvise personal items?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
 Critical thinking  Responsibility  Health issues
 Communication and  Love  Life skills
 collaboration  Respect
  Digital literacy
  Self-efficacy
LEARNING RESOURCES
Picture of personal items.
Materials for cleaning personal items: water, soap, brush.
Computers/tablets.
Focus on Hygiene and nutrition Grade 2 learners’ workbook pg. 29-35
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Review the previous lesson.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Guide the learners to identify the items they use when brushing their teeth, combing their hair,
 cleaning their face.
 Step 2: Guide the learners in the steps provided in the learner’s workbook on how to clean a toothbrush,
 comb, face towel.
 Step 3: Give learners an opportunity to clean a toothbrush, comb, face towel if possible.
 Step 4: Lead learners in a discussion on how they can improvise personal items in case the items are not
 available e.g. toothbrush.
SUMMARY
Review the lesson
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Cleaning personal items in important
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to promote personal hygiene among family members and friends.
